name: Cathedral
summary: What is death? These days, few people probably consider this question. However, in an era ravaged by plague and disaster, death is not unfamiliar to people; the difference lies in their attitudes towards it. Some are pessimistic, some are joyful, some are fearful, and some are at a loss. As a young child, you will unveil the mystery of death and find your true path to redemption in this world filled with sin and helplessness.
